patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: My left calf has been swollen, warm, and achy for a couple of days — the other leg's totally normal. I was in a cast recently. No chest pain or trouble breathing though.
presentation.triageNote: 58-year-old female with two days of swelling, warmth, and tenderness confined to the left calf after recent immobilization in a cast. The opposite leg is normal; she denies chest pain and shortness of breath.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 3 is appropriate because this stable suspected venous clot requires multiple resources including vascular imaging and laboratory assessment before anticoagulation.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has unilateral calf swelling, warmth, and tenderness after immobilization, without current cardiopulmonary symptoms.
clinical.acuityReason: The presentation is stable but strongly suggests venous thrombosis and requires imaging and treatment planning; the absence of chest symptoms is reassuring against clinically apparent embolization.
expectedResources: CBC, renal function, and coagulation testing
keyFindings: Warmth and tenderness confined to one calf
No chest pain or shortness of breath
teachingPoints: Unilateral swelling plus a provoking risk factor should prompt objective clot assessment.
New chest pain, dyspnea, syncope, tachycardia, or hypoxemia would raise concern for embolization.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Ultrasound and baseline testing would guide anticoagulation and determine whether outpatient treatment is safe.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, one leg extended showing a swollen calf
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 58-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: one leg extended forward showing a swollen calf. Expression: mildly uncomfortable and concerned. Clearly visible: one visibly swollen lower leg. No text, no logos.
